Info

Defines SubProcessor adapter implementing ISubProcessor protocol.

class gen_test.infrastructure.subprocessor.SubProcessor(parser: ICppParser, mock_gen: IMockGenerator, test_gen: ITestGenerator, fake_gen: IFakeGenerator, cmake_gen: ICMakeGenerator, main_gen: MainGenerator, formatter: CodeFormatter)[source]¶
